verdict.rationale: The only bulk capability in the evidence is acknowledging many simultaneous incidents (10–30) with a single tap. That is a narrow, human-UI bulk action. Nothing shows bulk editing or creating of monitors or other resources, and nothing shows bulk endpoints in the API or MCP server that an AI-native workflow could drive. Missing for 10: bulk create/update/delete via API or MCP, bulk operations beyond incident acknowledgement, documented batch endpoints, independent corroboration.
